turns.q: How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyText:
For US orders, Standard Shipping is estimated **3–7 business days**. Expedited options (when available for your address) are **2 business days** or **1 business day** if you order by **3pm ET**. Processing for standard domestic and international orders can take up to **4 business days**.

Full details are here: [shipping options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options)

Returns are pretty straightforward as long as the items are unworn, unused, in original condition with tags attached, and you start the return within 30 days of delivery.

You can start here: [Fashion Nova Returns Portal](https://returns.fashionnova.com/fashionnova/returns)
